panes.title: 09-semantic
panes.source:
(define combine
  (network [a b]
    (+ (* a 2) b)))
(define left 3)
(define right 4)
(def-cells result)
(-> (combine left right) result)
(display
  (relationship:with-values
    (relationship:semantic left)))
